title: Bodycon Cutout 솔로 #108 · super hourglass · 옆 곡선 파임 + 가운데 판 · spandex · 머리 넘기기 · 여름 해변 · 코갸루
prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a deep ebony-brown complexion, late 30s goddess, super hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — waist cinched to absolute impossible minimum, hips AND bust simultaneously flaring to absolute maximum beyond any proportion, most dramatic hourglass ratio ever recorded on any human body, thighs so thick pressing together, long curly chestnut brown hair — wearing a skin-tight micro bodycon mini dress of ultra-thin matte scarlet-red spandex with thin shoulder straps, the front zipper pulled down the center of her chest to her belly button, the two sides of the spandex fully covering her bust, both sides of the dress cut away in deep curved scoops from under her bust down to her hips, her whole waist sides and flanks bare, leaving only a narrow center panel of the spandex about three fingers wide down the middle of her stomach that joins the bust to the skirt, a plain ultra-high slit cut up the left side of the dress from the hem to her hip bone, the slit baring her whole left thigh and the side of her left hip, the hem ending just below her hip bones, a micro length hardly longer than a belt, her arms and legs bare, the spandex shrink-wrapped onto her body like a second skin, fully opaque, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin on her face, neck, arms, hands, stomach, thighs and legs, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and slightly darker skin over her elbows. The garments cling like a second skin and show real material behaviour: the thin spandex molded so closely that it shows the soft relief of her collarbones, her hip bones and the gentle rise of her bust and hips, the narrow center panel and the clean curved edges of the scoops, the dress stretched taut over the curve of her hips and glutes, the open slit falling in a clean line, fine stretch lines and a soft matte sheen. Pose: one hand sweeping her hair back, the other resting on her hip, one leg crossed in front to show the boot — most extreme super hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of glossy scarlet red leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, curved talon nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in scarlet red lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and heavy gold rings on every finger. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Black woman with strong, striking features, a broad nose and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: clearly visible, bold and well defined: bold white eyeshadow across the lids, white glossy lips, a bright turquoise liner accent at the outer corners, long lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights.

Background: a bright white-sand beach at midday with calm turquoise water, a wooden boardwalk with a waist-high rail and a row of closed striped cabanas of normal door height, just after the rain, with wet surfaces shining softly, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
